title.narrative: ECT 2 Appui aux services de sécurité sur la thématique de la lutte contre les violences faites aux femmes

description.narrative:
Appui aux associations travaillant dans la lutte contre les violences faites aux femmes Expertise visant à soutenir la mise en oeuvre de l'intervention "MOR 16 054 11"
- Assistant Technique National en matière de VBG - Assistant Technique National en matière de numérisation et digitalisation - Assistant Technique National en matière de VBG :
L'AT est en charge d’assurer l’accompagnement de la Direction Générale de la Sécurité Nationale (DGSN) et la Gendarmerie Royale (GR) en faveur de la prise en charge des femmes victimes de violences. Plus particulièrement, la personne est en charge de l’appui au perfectionnement des services offerts par la DGSN et la GR aux femmes victimes de violences. La personne apportera un soutien technique en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les services dédiés au sein de la DGSN et GR et les autres partenaires travaillant dans le même domaine (société civile, autres ministères et PTF).
- Assistant Technique National en matière de numérisation et digitalisation :
L’AT est en charge d’assurer l’accompagnement de la Direction Générale de la Sécurité Nationale (DGSN) et la Gendarmerie Royale (GR) dans les choix visant l’intégration de la numérisation et la digitalisation en faveur de la prise en charge des femmes victimes de violences. The ECT 2 Appui aux services de securite sur la thematique de la lutte contre les violences faites aux femmes is a project in Morocco, focusing on government and civil society efforts to end violence against women and girls. This intervention aligns with the fourth component of the ICRAM2 (Integrated National Action Plan for Human Rights), specifically addressing violence against women (Protection of Women and Strengthening of Their Rights). The project aims to improve the quality of integrated responses to situations of violence and support for victims, ensuring adequate response for women and girls who are victims of violence. The intervention strengthens the capacities of security actors for increased reactivity, better management of reception, listening, support, orientation, and accompaniment of victims. The project also supports a dialogue between security service actors and other stakeholders involved in the care and support of women victims of violence (health, justice, emergency housing, civil society). The project is anchored in national policies and the Belgian strategy, meeting commitments regarding the effectiveness of aid, and is highly relevant to the needs of the target group. At this stage of implementation, the intervention logic, as it has been developed, remains appropriate. The project aims to improve the care provided to women victims of violence by supporting the mechanisms for care of women victims, whose mandates are described in the new "Loi 103-13 relative a la lutte contre les violences faites aux femmes," adopted in 2018. The project adapts its strategies and activities to external circumstances in order to achieve the intended outcome. Risks are managed proactively, and nine months after the signing of the cooperation agreement, the project adapts according to the evolution of circumstances. The majority of inputs are available within reasonable timeframes and do not require significant budget adjustments; however, some room for improvement is possible.
